definition: **Lay-off** — failure/refusal/inability of employer to give employment due to shortage of coal/power/raw material, accumulation of stock, breakdown, or natural calamity (with conditions). **Retrenchment** — termination for any reason other than disciplinary penalty (with **last-in-first-out** and compensation norms). **Closure** — permanent shut-down of establishment (compensation and notice for affected workmen in applicable establishments).

statutoryReferences.note: Chapter V-B style protections for large establishments — verify thresholds
